text: Ko onon yo gomɗimɓe Alla e Nulaaɗo, ñiiɓee e nunɗal, seedoɗon goonga, hay si tawii non ko e hoore-mon, maa e hoore jibimɓe on ɓen maa ɓadondiraaɓe mon ɓen. Wata ngalu maa baasal goɗɗo sakko on e seedagol ngol, tawde ko Alla Ɓuri Hanndude on baaso maaɗum galo. Wata on jokku mbeleeɗe ɗen ka seedagol haa ooñoɗon gaay e goonga kan. Si on waylii seedagol ngol on seedorike noone goo, maa on ɗuurnike e seedagol ngol ; haray pellet, Alla Laatike Humpitiiɗo ko golloton kon.
